opportunities.name: Expedia car rental search with filters
opportunities.description: Search Expedia rental cars for a pick-up location, date range and times, then apply filters and sorting to results.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab
Click Pick-up, type location, select suggestion
Set drop-off to same as pick-up or another location
Open pick-up date picker, choose start and end dates, click Done
Select pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Apply result filters (car type, capacity, company) and sort

instances.values: pickup JFK, dropoff JFK, Apr 5-6 (partial entry)
JFK to JFK, Apr 3-6, 9am-6pm, Luxury + 2-5 passengers, sort total price
San Francisco, Apr 2-8 (picked 8-9), Avis + Economy filters

opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search to ticket selection
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com flights (one-way or multi-city) for origin, destination, date and passengers, sort by fastest with direct filter, and proceed through selecting a flight and ticket type.
steps: Click Flights tab
Choose trip type (one way / multi-city / round trip) and direct-only option
Enter origin airport and select it
Enter destination airport and select it
Pick departure date(s)
Set passenger count if needed and click Search
Click Fastest tab
Click See flight, then Select
Choose ticket type and click Next

instances.values: One-way Columbus/Bangalore to Goa, 29 Mar, 2 adults, direct only
Multi-city New York to Tokyo 1 Jun, Tokyo to Delhi 5 Jun

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search by destination, departure port and date
opportunities.description: Use Carnival's search bar to choose Sail To destination, optional departure port, date and duration, search cruises, then refine by number of guests.
steps: Click Sail To and choose destination
Optionally click Sail From and choose port
Optionally click Dates and choose month
Click Search Cruises
Open Number of Guests filter, adjust count, close

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route and date
opportunities.description: Look up MTA Planned Service Changes for a subway/bus route on a chosen date.
steps: Open Planned Work / Planned Service Changes page
Type route in Search Routes and select it
Open date picker and navigate to target month
Click target day
Read results

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero airport parking by choosing an airport and optionally start/end dates.
steps: Open SpotHero homepage, click Airport tab
Type airport name/code in search box
Select matching airport from list
Choose parking start and end dates
Optionally sort results
